items.group: Bought
items.name: JazzUpCo Ava flatware, Mirror Gold, 4-person set (20 pieces)
items.note: Fifth purchase, 11/27. 18/10 stainless with a titanium PVD gold coating, weighted handles, dishwasher safe. Mirror gold against the dusty pink plates and amber glass: warmer and a touch shinier than the satin gold I'd floated, which suits the 70s lean of the palette. Care: dishwasher is fine, but skip citrus or lemon-scented detergents and don't let it sit wet; that's what dulls PVD gold over time. Matching serving pieces and steak knives exist if you want them later.

items.group: Target run (Casaluna and the move-in basics)

items.note: The pick after the Black Friday cookware roundup: for one person with a Ninja PossibleCooker doing the soups, rice and braises, three good pieces beat a 12-piece set that fills a cabinet. Tri-ply stainless works on gas, electric and induction, so buy the fry pan and saucepan first and check the cooktop on the visit before buying the aluminum nonstick skillet (not induction-safe). Fry pan from Amazon, skillet and saucepan on the Target run or Amazon, whichever is cheaper that day. If you'd rather have one box: Tramontina tri-ply 12-piece, about $190 at Costco or Amazon. Black Friday sets seen 11/27 for reference: Figmint 12-pc ceramic about $114–180, Caraway 12-pc $356, All-Clad HA1 10-pc $419.99, HexClad 12-pc $569.
